summary: Backend-only verification of new PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/role endpoint and support-request gating (require_admin_or_support). 14/14 pytest cases pass against the preview backend.

minor.issue: Seeded user client@handyhub.com / Admin2024! returns 401 (Invalid credentials). The credentials file /app/memory/test_credentials.md claims this account is auto-seeded but it is not actually login-able on the preview backend. provider@handyhub.com not verified; only admin@handyhub.com login works. Tests worked around it by registering throwaway client users.

PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/role.support: 200, role persisted and visible via /auth/me after re-login
PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/role.moderator: 200, auto-grants full moderator_modules = [tasks, bookings, users, payments, reviews, messages, services, analytics, settings]
PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/role.admin: 200 (admin CAN promote others to admin), moderator_modules cleared to []

action_items: Optional: re-seed or document the actual state of client@handyhub.com / provider@handyhub.com — the credentials file (/app/memory/test_credentials.md) is stale on the preview environment. The admin account works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 11208 lines — should be split into modular routers (users, admin, support, etc.) to respect the <700-line guideline.
change_user_role correctly excludes MongoDB _id from the user lookup and uses Pydantic-style validation on role; behavior matches spec.
moderator_modules is cleared on every non-moderator transition — correct behavior; verified by test_change_role_to_admin_clears_modules.
test_credentials: admin@handyhub.com / Admin2024! (works). client@handyhub.com / Admin2024! does NOT work on preview backend — register throwaway users instead.
seed_data_creation: Each test registers throwaway users with TEST_/test_role_/test_supp_ email prefixes. Not cleaned up — recommend adding cleanup if rerunning frequently.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoint PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/role at server.py:3265 is fully working. Support role gating via require_admin_or_support (server.py:1307) on /admin/support-requests endpoints is working. Use admin@handyhub.com / Admin2024! for admin token; do NOT trust client@handyhub.com — register a fresh client via POST /api/auth/register (note: field is 'name' not 'full_name').
